derivation: fun X n i hi hX => (isGE_iff X n).mp hX i hi
explanation: `DerivedCategory.isGE_iff X n` states `X.IsGE n ↔ ∀ (i : ℤ), i < n → IsZero ((homologyFunctor C i).obj X)`. The judged lemma is exactly the forward direction of this equivalence with the hypothesis `[X.IsGE n]` taken as an argument; the library's proof performs precisely `rw [isGE_iff] at hX; exact hX i hi`. So it is a one-line corollary of `isGE_iff` (which is independent of the judged lemma: its proof only uses `CochainComplex.isGE_iff`, truncations and `homologyFunctorFactors`). The similar-looking `DerivedCategory.Plus.isZero_homology_of_isGE` is about `Plus C` and moreover is proved *from* the judged lemma, while `CochainComplex.isZero_of_isGE` concerns cochain complexes, not objects of the derived category (deriving the latter from it would need isomorphisms and homology functor comparisons, i.e. more than a couple of lines).
